item.title: Review: Hautepad C-AS Arcade Stick For Switch 1 & 2 - Unique & Eye-Catching, But Improvements Are Needed

description.p: Short goes a long way.Cosmox Gaming is best known for its leverless arcade controllers, and although it experimented with a modular joystick in its Hautepad X model, it has yet to fully embrace the more traditional arcade stick. Until now, that is.The Hautepad C-AS is a dedicated fight stick with a couple of neat tricks up its sleeve. The first is that it takes inspiration from Cosmox’s own C-AT controller by including adjustable buttons, meaning you can raise or lower the height of each input to suit your preferences. The second is that it includes modular ‘LS’ and ‘RS’ buttons that can be swapped out for analogue sticks. So, much like the SWORL or the Hautepad X, you can use the C-AS for more than just fighting games – if you can get used to the setup, of course.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Japanese Console Market Would Have Been "Eliminated" If Switch Failed, Says Analyst

description.p: A silent guardian, a watchful protector... A Nintendo Switch.We're all aware of just how successful the Switch has been since its launch in 2017. The latest figures put it at a total of 156.59 million units sold worldwide, which means that had Sony not managed to find some extra PS2 sales down the back of the couch in 2024, the Switch would be the best-selling console of all time. Alas, Sony added 5 million to the PS2's sales, totalling 160 million – boo.In a new interview with analyst Dr. Serkan Toto over at The Game Business, however, the Switch may have actually saved the Japanese console market from extinction. Essentially, had the Switch failed in a manner comparable to the Wii U, then Japanese gamers may have gravitated even further to mobile gaming and PC.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
